sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片当DJ的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，陈列着这些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, when President Trump announced that he would end DACA, he made it Congress's problem.
sentences.zh: 今天，当特朗普总统宣布他将终止“童年抵美者暂缓遣返计划”（DACA）时，他把这个问题抛给了国会。

sentences.en: They had six months to pass a bill or tens of thousands of undocumented children could be deported.
sentences.zh: 他们有六个月的时间通过一项法案，否则成千上万的无证移民儿童可能会被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: As the clock counts down, why is the president once again making it his problem?
sentences.zh: 随着倒计时开始，为什么总统又一次把这变成了他自己的难题？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, January 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月11日，星期四。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: I'm here today to announce that the program known as DACA that was effectuated under the Obama administration is being rescinded.
sentences.zh: 我今天来这里是为了宣布，奥巴马政府时期实施的DACA计划将被废除。

sentences.en: The DACA program was implemented in 2000.
sentences.zh: DACA计划是在2000年实施的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it was September 5th, I believe, of last year, almost two-thirds of the way through the president's first year in office.
sentences.zh: 那是去年的9月5日，我想，当时总统的第一任期已经过了近三分之二。

sentences.en: And Attorney General Jeff Sessions went out at the Justice Department and made this dramatic announcement.
sentences.zh: 司法部长杰夫·塞申斯在司法部发表了这一戏剧性的声明。

sentences.en: To have a lawful system of immigration that serves the national interest, we cannot admit everyone who would like to come here.
sentences.zh: 为了拥有一个符合国家利益的合法移民体系，我们不能接纳所有想来这里的人。

sentences.en: It's just that simple.
sentences.zh: 就是这么简单。

sentences.en: The administration was rescinding a program called DACA, Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals.
sentences.zh: 政府正在废除一项名为DACA的计划，即“童年抵美者暂缓遣返计划”。

sentences.en: Michael Scheer covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·希尔为《纽约时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: It was a program that was set up originally in 2012 by the Obama administration as a way of addressing a particularly sympathetic group of people.
sentences.zh: 这是一项最初由奥巴马政府在2012年设立的计划，旨在帮助一个特别值得同情的群体。

sentences.en: They were brought to this country by their parents, sometimes even as infants, and often have no idea that they're undocumented until...
sentences.zh: 他们被父母带到这个国家，有时甚至是婴儿时期，而且往往直到……才知道自己是无证移民。

sentences.en: And so the Obama administration had put into place a program that said, look, let's carve out this group of people and say we're not going to deport them.
sentences.zh: 所以奥巴马政府实施了一项计划，意思是，看，让我们把这群人单独列出来，说我们不会驱逐他们。

sentences.en: We're going to give them the ability to get a work permit so they can work here legally.
sentences.zh: 我们要让他们有能力获得工作许可，这样他们就能在这里合法工作。

sentences.en: It makes no sense to expel talented young people who, for all intents and purposes, are Americans.
sentences.zh: 驱逐那些在各方面实际上都是美国人的天才年轻人是毫无意义的。

sentences.en: And that was the status quo for something like five years, from 2012 to 2017.
sentences.zh: 这就是从2012年到2017年，大约五年间的现状。

sentences.en: The compassionate thing to do is end the lawlessness, enforce our laws.
sentences.zh: 仁慈的做法是结束这种无法无天的状态，执行我们的法律。

sentences.en: And if Congress chooses to make changes to those laws, to do so through the process set forth by our founders.
sentences.zh: 如果国会选择修改这些法律，就应该通过我们开国元勋制定的程序来进行。

sentences.en: But it's actually not that simple, right, that suddenly the president, through Jeff Sessions, is just shutting down DACA.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此简单，对吧？总统通过杰夫·塞申斯突然关闭DACA。

sentences.en: That's not exactly what he does.
sentences.zh: 他做的并不完全是那样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, look, part of the interesting thing about President Trump is that he is somewhat conflicted on this issue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看，关于特朗普总统，有趣的一点是他在这个问题上有些矛盾。

sentences.en: The DACA situation is a very, very, it's a very difficult thing for me because, you know, I love these kids.
sentences.zh: DACA的情况对我来说非常、非常困难，因为你知道，我爱这些孩子。

sentences.en: I love kids.
sentences.zh: 我爱孩子。

sentences.en: I have kids and grandkids.
sentences.zh: 我有孩子和孙辈。

sentences.en: And I find it very, very hard doing what the law says exactly to do.
sentences.zh: 我发现要完全按照法律所说的去做是非常、非常困难的。

sentences.en: And has a long history of expressing some of the same sympathies towards this group that others do.
sentences.zh: 而且他长期以来一直表达着与其他人对这个群体相同的同情心。

sentences.en: Actually, a little known fact is that President Trump, in 2013, long before he was a presidential candidate or had even sort of given thought about running for president,
sentences.zh: 事实上，一个鲜为人知的事实是，特朗普总统在2013年，远在他成为总统候选人，甚至还没考虑竞选总统之前，

sentences.en: he met with a group of these young immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他就曾与一群年轻的移民会面。

sentences.en: They're known as dreamers.
sentences.zh: 他们被称为“梦想家”。

sentences.en: And as I understand it, Gabby, you were in that meeting with Donald Trump a couple of years ago.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，加比，几年前你和唐纳德·特朗普参加了那次会议。

sentences.en: That's right, Alan.
sentences.zh: 没错，艾伦。

sentences.en: And he met with them in Trump Tower, sat around a table, had a long discussion with them.
sentences.zh: 他在特朗普大厦与他们会面，围坐在一张桌子旁，与他们进行了长时间的讨论。

sentences.en: And, you know, he asked the typical questions that people who are not well-versed and don't understand the immigration movement that is happening in the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他问了一些典型的问题，这些问题是那些不精通、不了解国内正在发生的移民运动的人会问的。

sentences.en: So we were able to explain some of those things to him.
sentences.zh: 所以我们能够向他解释其中的一些事情。

sentences.en: And then at the end of this meeting...
sentences.zh: 然后在会议结束时……

sentences.en: As they rode down the elevator, one of them told us that...
sentences.zh: 当他们乘电梯下楼时，其中一个人告诉我们……

sentences.en: He looked at us and said, you know, you convinced me.
sentences.zh: 他看着我们说，你知道，你们说服了我。

sentences.en: You know, we left there thinking, wow, Donald Trump understands and was able to hear us out and really ask questions that some people would be embarrassed of asking.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们离开时心想，哇，唐纳德·特朗普理解了，并且能够听取我们的意见，还问了一些别人可能会觉得尴尬的问题。

sentences.en: We were able to give them the answers to him.
sentences.zh: 我们能够给他答案。

sentences.en: That has clearly stuck with him.
sentences.zh: 这显然让他印象深刻。

sentences.en: So even on that day, on that September 5th day, when he sent out his attorney general to end the program,
sentences.zh: 所以即使在那一天，在9月5日那天，当他派他的司法部长去结束这个计划时，

sentences.en: President Trump had managed to figure out a way to do two things on the same day in pretty dramatic fashion.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统还是设法在同一天以相当戏剧性的方式完成了两件事。

sentences.en: On the one hand, he found a way to satisfy the sort of super conservative, anti-immigrant part of his base, which had always hated this Obama-era program.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他找到了一种方法来满足他那部分超级保守、反移民的支持者，他们一直讨厌这个奥巴马时代的计划。

sentences.en: They had seen it as an executive overreach, that Obama had just sort of waved a magic wand and kind of exempted this group of immigrants from sort of the normal immigration laws.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是行政越权，奥巴马只是挥动了一下魔杖，就把这群移民从正常的移民法中豁免了。

sentences.en: And so by sending out his very conservative attorney general to end it, he satisfied that part of his base.
sentences.zh: 所以通过派他那非常保守的司法部长去结束它，他满足了他那部分支持者。

sentences.en: But at the same time, and the reason why it's not so simple and why it's pretty interesting and dramatic on that day,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这也是为什么事情没那么简单，以及为什么那天的事情相当有趣和戏剧性的原因，

sentences.en: is that literally the moment that he did that, the moment he ended the program, he also challenged Congress to fix it.
sentences.zh: 就是在他做这件事的瞬间，在他结束该计划的瞬间，他也挑战国会去解决它。

sentences.en: Developing tonight, hours after the Trump administration announced it was phasing out the DACA program over the next six months,
sentences.zh: 今晚最新消息，在特朗普政府宣布将在未来六个月内逐步淘汰DACA计划数小时后，

sentences.en: President Trump tweeted, Congress now has six months to legalize DACA, something the Obama administration was unable to do.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统发推文说，国会现在有六个月的时间将DACA合法化，这是奥巴马政府无法做到的。

sentences.en: The end of that clock is March 5th, after which, if they don't act by March 5th,
sentences.zh: 那个期限的终点是3月5日，在那之后，如果他们不在3月5日前采取行动，

sentences.en: everyone knows that that's sort of the day that many, many of these young immigrants will start being affected by this.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道，那将是许多、许多年轻移民开始受到影响的日子。

sentences.en: I have to say, this strikes me as kind of a brilliant stroke on the part of the president, if it works.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，如果这能奏效，这在我看来是总统的一种妙招。

sentences.en: He doesn't alienate his supporters who put him in office and who have real reservations about something like a DREAM Act.
sentences.zh: 他没有疏远那些把他送进办公室、并且对《梦想法案》这类事情有真正保留意见的支持者。

sentences.en: But were Congress to solve this, were Congress to pass legislation protecting these DREAMers,
sentences.zh: 但如果国会能解决这个问题，如果国会能通过保护这些“梦想家”的立法，

sentences.en: it would actually be far stronger and more enduring than what President Obama had done,
sentences.zh: 它实际上会比奥巴马总统所做的要强大和持久得多，

sentences.en: which was an executive order, or what Trump would have done by just furthering the executive order.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马做的是行政命令，或者特朗普如果只是推进行政命令也会是这样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: No, exactly.
sentences.zh: 不，完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, look, President Obama tried to take the legislative approach during his time in office.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看，奥巴马总统在任期间曾试图采取立法途径。

sentences.en: And I've said time and time and time again to Congress, send me the DREAM Act, put it on my desk, and I will sign it right away.
sentences.zh: 我曾一次又一次地对国会说，把《梦想法案》送给我，放在我的办公桌上，我会立即签署。

sentences.en: They just couldn't get it through Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们就是无法在国会通过。

sentences.en: So the DACA program was an executive action that President Obama did out of frustration because he couldn't get the legislation passed.
sentences.zh: 所以DACA计划是奥巴马总统因无法通过立法而感到沮丧时采取的行政行动。

sentences.en: You know, fast forward to President Trump, and if he can, you know, help Republicans and Democrats in Congress to come together
sentences.zh: 你知道，快进到特朗普总统，如果他能，你知道，帮助国会中的共和党人和民主党人团结起来，

sentences.en: and actually do a version of the DREAM Act that was tried and failed several years ago,
sentences.zh: 并真正完成几年前尝试过但失败了的《梦想法案》版本，

sentences.en: it will actually be a much more permanent solution, a much better solution for these young immigrants.
sentences.zh: 这实际上将是一个更永久的解决方案，对这些年轻移民来说是一个更好的解决方案。

sentences.en: Because at the end of the day, they won't be subject to the whims of the next president who comes into office.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，他们不会再受制于下一任总统上任后的心血来潮。

sentences.en: They will simply have become permanent residents of the United States, and depending on how the legislation would be written,
sentences.zh: 他们将简单地成为美国的永久居民，并且根据立法的起草方式，

sentences.en: might have an opportunity at some point in the future to become citizens.
sentences.zh: 未来某个时候可能有机会成为公民。

sentences.en: So what's Congress been doing in the four months since this six-month clock started to count down?
sentences.zh: 那么在六个月倒计时开始后的四个月里，国会一直在做什么？

sentences.en: Are they trying to solve this problem?
sentences.zh: 他们是在试图解决这个问题吗？

sentences.en: So Congress does what Congress always does, which is they don't ever do things simply, right?
sentences.zh: 所以国会做了国会总是做的事情，那就是他们从来不简单地做事，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, it's never as simple as just let's take this one issue and let's talk about it and debate it and vote on it, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，从来没有像“让我们只处理这个问题，让我们讨论它、辩论它并投票表决它”那么简单，对吧？

sentences.en: So both sides looked at this question of how to deal with the young immigrants and said, how can we improve our leverage, you know, so that we get what we want?
sentences.zh: 所以双方都审视了如何处理年轻移民这个问题，并说，我们怎样才能提高我们的筹码，你知道，以便我们得到我们想要的？

sentences.en: It is going to be an eventful few days on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 国会山将迎来充满变数的几天。

sentences.en: Let's get to Elon Mui, who can set the table for us on that.
sentences.zh: 让我们连线埃隆·穆伊，让他为我们梳理一下情况。

sentences.en: Elon, good morning.
sentences.zh: 埃隆，早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning, Carl.
sentences.zh: 早上好，卡尔。

sentences.en: Well, Senator Chuck Schumer and Representative Nancy Pelosi have said they are willing to support a deal that would raise the national debt limit for three months.
sentences.zh: 嗯，参议员查克·舒默和众议员南希·佩洛西表示，他们愿意支持一项将国家债务上限提高三个月的协议。

sentences.en: Now, that is the offer from Democrats, but it's unclear if Republicans will accept it.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是民主党人的提议，但不清楚共和党人是否会接受。

sentences.en: What I do think is very interesting is the wall is so critically important to him,
sentences.zh: 我确实认为非常有趣的是，那堵墙对他来说至关重要，

sentences.en: and DACA and maintaining it is so critically important to Democrats that he is using that as the ultimate bargaining chip here.
sentences.zh: 而DACA及其维持对民主党人来说至关重要，所以他正在利用这一点作为这里的终极谈判筹码。

sentences.en: Will he get his way?
sentences.zh: 他能如愿以偿吗？

sentences.en: So both sides started posturing.
sentences.zh: 所以双方都开始摆姿态。

sentences.en: There was this remarkable dinner.
sentences.zh: 那是一场非凡的晚餐。

sentences.en: The president, late Wednesday, working around his own party, hosted Chuck Schumer and Nancy Pelosi at the White House.
sentences.zh: 周三晚些时候，总统绕过他自己的党派，在白宫接待了查克·舒默和南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: Well, we had an invitation, Chuck Schumer and I, Leader Schumer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们收到了一份邀请，查克·舒默和我，舒默领袖。

sentences.en: On the menu, tax reform, border security, infrastructure, trade, and how to resolve the dispute over so-called dreamers.
sentences.zh: 菜单上有税收改革、边境安全、基础设施、贸易，以及如何解决关于所谓“梦想家”的争议。

sentences.en: The president said, you know, he supported the DREAM Act.
sentences.zh: 总统说，你知道，他支持《梦想法案》。

sentences.en: And they sort of talked it through with a bunch of aides there.
sentences.zh: 他们和一群助手在那里讨论了一番。

sentences.en: And what everybody said was, oh, we've got a deal.
sentences.zh: 每个人都说，哦，我们达成协议了。

sentences.en: The president and the Democrats agreed.
sentences.zh: 总统和民主党人达成了一致。

sentences.en: A deal on DACA.
sentences.zh: 关于DACA的协议。

sentences.en: A deal on DACA.
sentences.zh: 关于DACA的协议。

sentences.en: After the sit-down the Democratic leaders announcing, we agreed to enshrine the protections of DACA into law quickly and to work out a package of border security,
sentences.zh: 会谈后，民主党领导人宣布，我们同意迅速将DACA的保护措施写入法律，并制定一套边境安全方案，

sentences.en: excluding the wall that's acceptable to both sides.
sentences.zh: 排除双方都能接受的墙的问题。

sentences.en: We're not going to tie the wall to dreamers.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把墙和“梦想家”捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: That's a very, very good thing and good progress.
sentences.zh: 那是非常、非常好的一件事，也是很好的进展。

sentences.en: I've told him over and over again.
sentences.zh: 我一遍又一遍地告诉他。

sentences.en: At one point, he said to me, go easy on the wall.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他对我说，在墙的问题上放轻松点。

sentences.en: I said, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，不。

sentences.en: But the minute that that dinner ended and everybody left.
sentences.zh: 但就在那次晚餐结束，每个人都离开的那一刻。

sentences.en: President Trump is pushing back this morning against Democratic claims that they have a framework for a deal to save nearly 700,000 young immigrants from deportation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统今天早上反驳了民主党人的说法，即他们已经达成了一个框架协议，以拯救近70万名年轻移民免于被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: The president tweeting a short time ago, no deal was made last night on DACA.
sentences.zh: 总统不久前发推文说，昨晚没有就DACA达成任何协议。

sentences.en: Massive border security would have to be agreed to in exchange for consent, would be subject to vote.
sentences.zh: 大规模的边境安全必须作为同意的交换条件，并需经过投票表决。

sentences.en: The normal partisan mechanisms in Washington kicked in.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿正常的党派机制开始发挥作用。

sentences.en: And so within, I don't know, a few days, a couple of weeks, it was pretty clear that whatever quote-unquote deal both sides might have thought had been struck,
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道，在几天、几周内，很明显，无论双方可能认为达成了什么所谓的协议，

sentences.en: like there wasn't a deal that was sealed that night.
sentences.zh: 就像那天晚上并没有达成什么确定的协议一样。

sentences.en: And so for that reason, this six-month clock that you've been describing is still ticking with no deal.
sentences.zh: 因此，你所描述的六个月倒计时仍在滴答作响，而没有任何协议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's no deal.
sentences.zh: 没有协议。

sentences.en: And ultimately, that's what led the president to invite members of Congress from both parties and both chambers to the White House on Tuesday
sentences.zh: 最终，这导致总统在周二邀请了来自两党和两院的国会议员到白宫，

sentences.en: for what ended up being this remarkable discussion, hour-long broadcast on television, where they really sort of confronted this question and how to solve it.
sentences.zh: 进行了一场非凡的讨论，在电视上直播了一个小时，他们真正面对了这个问题以及如何解决它。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《交易手册》（DealBook）报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的《交易手册》峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过NYTimes.com直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: So, Mike, what happens in this televised meeting at the White House on Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，周二在白宫举行的这场电视会议上发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much, everyone, for being here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢大家来到这里。

sentences.en: I'm thrilled to...
sentences.zh: 我很高兴……

sentences.en: The president gathered all of these lawmakers around in the cabinet room.
sentences.zh: 总统把所有这些议员聚集在内阁会议室。

sentences.en: We're here today to advance bipartisan immigration reform that serves the needs of the American...
sentences.zh: 我们今天在这里是为了推进两党移民改革，以服务于美国的需求……

sentences.en: Normally, the press is brought in for just the first couple of minutes and then let out so that the meeting can happen in private.
sentences.zh: 通常，媒体只被允许进入前几分钟，然后就会被请出去，以便会议可以私下进行。

sentences.en: In this case...
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下……

sentences.en: Maybe the press can stay for a little while and a couple of folks can make statements.
sentences.zh: 也许媒体可以留一会儿，几个人可以发表声明。

sentences.en: The press was brought in and then they were just allowed to stay as the meeting went on and on and on for almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 媒体被带了进来，然后他们就被允许留下来，会议持续了近一个小时。

sentences.en: And I think we're going to come up with an answer.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们会得出一个答案。

sentences.en: I hope we're going to come up with an answer for DACA.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能为DACA得出一个答案。

sentences.en: And then we go further than that later on down the road.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在以后的日子里走得更远。

sentences.en: And everybody in all the different sides were trying to make their point.
sentences.zh: 所有不同立场的人都在试图表达他们的观点。

sentences.en: So you had the Democrats...
sentences.zh: 所以你有民主党人……

sentences.en: We need to take care of these DACA kids.
sentences.zh: 我们需要照顾这些DACA的孩子们。

sentences.en: And we all agree on that.
sentences.zh: 我们都同意这一点。

sentences.en: Eighty-six percent of the American public agrees on that.
sentences.zh: 百分之八十六的美国公众对此表示赞同。

sentences.en: 900 of them are members of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 其中900人是美国

sentences.en: military.
sentences.zh: 军方成员。

sentences.en: 20,000 of them are schoolteachers.
sentences.zh: 其中2万人是学校教师。

sentences.en: Repeatedly trying to make their case to the president that, you know, let's just do this very simply, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 他们反复向总统陈述他们的理由，你知道，总统先生，让我们把事情简单化。

sentences.en: Let's just take the DREAM Act and let's pass it.
sentences.zh: 我们直接通过《梦想法案》吧。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Like, not get bogged down by a lot of other stuff.
sentences.zh: 比如，不要被其他琐事所困扰。

sentences.en: Lives are hanging in the balance of our getting the job done.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作成效关系到人们的命运。

sentences.en: And then on the Republican side...
sentences.zh: 而在共和党方面……

sentences.en: We saw two recent terror attacks in New York that were the result of this, I think, failed immigration policy.
sentences.zh: 我们看到纽约最近发生了两起恐怖袭击，我认为这是移民政策失败的结果。

sentences.en: We'd like to see that fixed.
sentences.zh: 我们希望能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: You had a bunch of the Republicans urging the president not so faSt.
sentences.zh: 有一群共和党人敦促总统不要操之过急。

sentences.en: We're going to address the border enforcement and security and the wall.
sentences.zh: 我们要处理边境执法、安全和边境墙的问题。

sentences.en: Let's make sure that we do this as a package and that, you know, makes more sense for their constituencies.
sentences.zh: 我们要确保将其作为一个整体方案来处理，你知道，这对他们的选民来说更有意义。

sentences.en: But if we do not do something with the security, if we do not do something with the chain migration, we are fooling each other.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们不在安全问题上采取行动，不在链式移民问题上采取行动，我们就是在自欺欺人。

sentences.en: And then there was one moment that crystallized the tension in that back and forth when...
sentences.zh: 当时有一个时刻，让那种来回拉锯的紧张气氛达到了顶点，当时……

sentences.en: Senator, would you like to say something, Diane?
sentences.zh: 参议员，你想说点什么吗，黛安？

sentences.en: Senator Dianne Feinstein, a Democrat of California, a veteran of the Senate for the last several decades, sees an opportunity and takes it.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州民主党参议员黛安·范斯坦，这位在参议院工作了数十年的老将，看到了机会并抓住了它。

sentences.en: What about a clean DACA bill now?
sentences.zh: 现在通过一项纯粹的《童年抵美者暂缓遣返》（DACA）法案怎么样？

sentences.en: He tries to convince the president that the best way to go is to just do a clean DREAM Act, something for these young immigrants,
sentences.zh: 他试图说服总统，最好的办法就是通过一项纯粹的《梦想法案》，为这些年轻的移民做点什么，

sentences.en: without loading it up with a bunch of other things.
sentences.zh: 而不是在里面塞进一大堆其他东西。

sentences.en: I have no problem.
sentences.zh: 我没意见。

sentences.en: I think that's basically what Dick is saying.
sentences.zh: 我想这基本上就是迪克所说的。

sentences.en: We're going to come out with...
sentences.zh: 我们将提出……

sentences.en: And the president seemed to agree.
sentences.zh: 总统似乎同意了。

sentences.en: I would like to do that.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意这样做。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 继续吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, you could sense that the Democrats in the room were like, wow, that's like a real moment.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你能感觉到房间里的民主党人当时心想，哇，这真是个关键时刻。

sentences.en: I need to be clear, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，我需要说明白。

sentences.en: I think what Senator Feinstein's asking here...
sentences.zh: 我想范斯坦参议员在这里要求的是……

sentences.en: And then Representative Kevin McCarthy, a Republican from California also, and in the leadership in the House, and was somebody who you could see it on his face.
sentences.zh: 然后是众议员凯文·麦卡锡，他也是来自加州的共和党人，在众议院担任领导职务，你可以从他的脸上看出来。

sentences.en: He realized that this was...
sentences.zh: 他意识到这是……

sentences.en: Like a panic.
sentences.zh: 就像一阵恐慌。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: DACA without security.
sentences.zh: 没有安全保障的DACA。

sentences.en: Are you talking about security as well?
sentences.zh: 你也在谈论安全问题吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think if we have some meaningful, comprehensive immigration reform, that's really where the security goes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为如果我们能进行一些有意义的、全面的移民改革，那才是安全问题的真正归宿。

sentences.en: The president had just sort of seemed to suggest that they were going to sort of abandon all of their efforts to get tougher immigration restrictions on who can come into the country,
sentences.zh: 总统刚才似乎暗示他们将放弃所有关于收紧入境人员限制的努力，

sentences.en: tougher enforcement at the border.
sentences.zh: 以及加强边境执法。

sentences.en: It's kind of like three pillars.
sentences.zh: 这就像是三个支柱。

sentences.en: DACA, because we're all in the room, want to do it.
sentences.zh: DACA，因为我们在座的各位都想通过它。

sentences.en: Border security, so we're not back out here, and chain migration.
sentences.zh: 边境安全，这样我们就不用再为此争论，还有链式移民。

sentences.en: There was sort of back and forth between Feinstein and McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 范斯坦和麦卡锡之间进行了一番交锋。

sentences.en: Do you really think that there can be agreement on all of that quickly?
sentences.zh: 你真的认为所有这些问题都能很快达成一致吗？

sentences.en: And, of course, we know from coverage of the president over the whole year that, like, oftentimes where he ends up is in the position of whoever whispered in his ear laSt.
sentences.zh: 当然，从我们这一整年对总统的报道中可以看出，他最终的立场往往取决于最后在他耳边吹风的人。

sentences.en: So you could see around the table and in that moment, both sides trying to be that voice in his head, sort of the last voice to convince him to go one direction.
sentences.zh: 所以在那一刻，你可以看到桌子周围双方都在试图成为他脑海中的那个声音，也就是试图说服他朝某个方向发展的最后一个声音。

sentences.en: Thank you all very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So then what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So the meeting breaks up at the White House, and it was really only a few hours later that...
sentences.zh: 白宫的会议结束后，仅仅几个小时后……

sentences.en: A new roadblock to the Trump administration's move to end DACA.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府终止DACA的举措遇到了新的阻碍。

sentences.en: A federal judge in California issues a ruling on this very program, on the DACA program.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州的一名联邦法官对这个项目，也就是DACA项目，做出了一项裁决。

sentences.en: A federal judge blocking the Trump administration's decision to end the Dreamers program on March 5th.
sentences.zh: 一名联邦法官阻止了特朗普政府在3月5日终止“梦想者”项目的决定。

sentences.en: Essentially what the judge said is that the president's decision back in September, on September 5th, when he had the attorney general announce the end to the DACA program,
sentences.zh: 法官本质上说的是，总统在九月份，也就是9月5日，让司法部长宣布终止DACA项目时的决定，

sentences.en: that decision was essentially illegal.
sentences.zh: 那个决定本质上是非法的。

sentences.en: That the administration had not followed the proper procedures to end the DACA program.
sentences.zh: 政府在终止DACA项目时没有遵循适当的程序。

sentences.en: And you can't just take something away with a stroke of a pen.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅凭笔一挥就取消某件事。

sentences.en: And he issued a nationwide injunction, basically said the government has to restart the DACA program and start giving back those benefits to people.
sentences.zh: 他发布了一项全国性的禁令，基本上要求政府重启DACA项目，并开始恢复人们的那些福利。

sentences.en: Now, you know, the trick here is that the legal process moves slowly.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道，这里的诀窍在于法律程序进展缓慢。

sentences.en: And it's not at all clear with the appeals that are likely and what impact the legal case will actually have.
sentences.zh: 而且考虑到可能的上诉，这个法律案件到底会有什么影响，目前还不清楚。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, the political process is continuing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，政治进程仍在继续。

sentences.en: And I think talking to Democrats, Republicans, the White House, there is a real sense that even though the judge's ruling on Tuesday night was, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为与民主党人、共和党人和白宫交谈后，有一种真实的感觉，尽管周二晚上的法官裁决，你知道，

sentences.en: amazing that it came on that same night of the White House meeting.
sentences.zh: 它恰好发生在白宫会议的同一天，这很令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But that really, at the end of the day, nobody expects the legal process to be the one to solve this.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，没有人指望法律程序能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like everybody understands ultimately the political process is the one that's going to matter.
sentences.zh: 就像每个人都明白，最终起作用的还是政治进程。

sentences.en: So is this timing just happened to be a coincidence that on the same day that the White House holds this session on DACA and whether to renew it, the judge,
sentences.zh: 那么，白宫在同一天举行关于DACA及其是否续期的会议，而法官也在同一天对DACA做出了一项相当重要的裁决，这仅仅是巧合吗？

sentences.en: this judge makes a ruling on DACA that's quite consequential.
sentences.zh: 这位法官做出了裁决。

sentences.en: We have no transparency into the judge's decision making.
sentences.zh: 我们无法了解法官的决策过程。

sentences.en: My suspicion is that it's not accidental, you know, that the judge has been considering this case for, you know, weeks now, if not months.
sentences.zh: 我的怀疑是这并非偶然，你知道，法官已经考虑这个案件好几周，甚至好几个月了。

sentences.en: The lawsuits were filed back in the fall.
sentences.zh: 诉讼是在去年秋天提起的。

sentences.en: And I have no reporting to suggest one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何报道能说明是哪种情况。

sentences.en: But did he decide, hey, this is not a bad opportunity, this is not a bad moment to release this decision?
sentences.zh: 但他是否决定，嘿，这是一个不错的机会，现在发布这个决定时机不错？

sentences.en: It's certainly possible.
sentences.zh: 这当然是有可能的。

sentences.en: Mike, it seems like whether the timing of this ruling was coincidental or not, it offers an explanation for why President Trump,
sentences.zh: 迈克，似乎无论这项裁决的时机是否巧合，它都解释了为什么特朗普总统，

sentences.en: after trying to make DACA Congress's problem rather than his problem, has now come back to this issue and is trying to help get a bill passed.
sentences.zh: 在试图把DACA变成国会的问题而不是他自己的问题之后，现在又回到了这个问题上，并试图帮助通过一项法案。

sentences.en: Because all last year, we saw him using executive authority to deal with immigration, with the travel ban, and just getting blocked through the courts over and over.
sentences.zh: 因为去年一整年，我们看到他利用行政权力处理移民问题，包括旅行禁令，结果在法庭上一次又一次地受阻。

sentences.en: So is this court ruling just another example of something that President Trump seems to have already figured out and is exhausted by,
sentences.zh: 那么，这项法院裁决是否只是特朗普总统似乎已经意识到并感到厌倦的另一个例子，

sentences.en: which is that executive action is just legally fraud and temporary and not a real way to get a problem solved?
sentences.zh: 那就是行政命令在法律上是脆弱且暂时的，并不是解决问题的真正方法？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you're exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: I think it is a reminder of the risks that you take when you try to make big, broad, consequential public policy outside of the normal legislative process.
sentences.zh: 我认为这提醒了人们，当你试图在正常的立法程序之外制定重大、广泛且影响深远的公共政策时，所承担的风险。

sentences.en: And that the judge's ruling in this lawsuit underscores better than anybody could possibly have done that, you know, when you make policy that way, it becomes completely, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且法官在这次诉讼中的裁决比任何人可能做到的都更能强调这一点，你知道，当你以这种方式制定政策时，它就完全，你知道，

sentences.en: sort of wrapped up in this legal quagmire.
sentences.zh: 陷入了这种法律泥潭。

sentences.en: That you've got, you know, judges in California and appellate court judges and ultimately the Supreme Court, you know,
sentences.zh: 你有加州的法官、上诉法院的法官，最终还有最高法院，你知道，

sentences.en: likely to get involved in a process that ultimately shouldn't be about, you know, judges and legal questions, right?
sentences.zh: 很可能会卷入一个最终不应该由法官和法律问题来决定的过程，对吧？

sentences.en: It's ultimately a question of what's the consensus in the country of what should be done with these young immigrants?
sentences.zh: 这最终是一个关于国家对如何处理这些年轻移民达成什么共识的问题。

sentences.en: Even as the legal and the political process goes forward,
sentences.zh: 即使法律和政治进程在推进，

sentences.en: that's the question that's hanging over these children is what will their fate be and will it be resolved with some kind of an ultimate political solution or will it continue to be uncertain and left to the whims of,
sentences.zh: 悬在这些孩子头上的问题是，他们的命运将会如何？是会通过某种最终的政治解决方案来解决，还是会继续不确定，并任由，

sentences.en: you know, kind of uncertain legal process?
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种不确定的法律程序摆布？

sentences.en: And that's that's what we don't know the answer to yet.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们还不知道答案的地方。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mike.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克。

sentences.en: Yes, sure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Happy to do it.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能帮忙。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, prominent House Republicans came forward with a proposal for a strict immigration bill that directly clashes with President Trump's efforts at a bipartisan deal.
sentences.zh: 周三，众议院共和党高层提出了一项严格的移民法案，这与特朗普总统推动两党协议的努力直接冲突。

sentences.en: The proposal would crack down on illegal and legal immigration and offer three-year renewable work permits to DACA recipients without offering them a path to citizenship.
sentences.zh: 该提案将打击非法和合法移民，并为DACA受益人提供三年可续签的工作许可，但不提供入籍途径。

sentences.en: While the plan is unlikely to make it out of the House, it signals how difficult it could be for Congress and the White House to come to an agreement.
sentences.zh: 虽然该计划不太可能在众议院获得通过，但它表明国会和白宫达成协议有多么困难。

sentences.en: At the same time, some liberal Democrats are adamant that they will not vote for a government funding measure without a deal on immigration.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一些自由派民主党人坚持认为，如果不在移民问题上达成协议，他们就不会投票支持政府拨款法案。

sentences.en: And funding is set to expire on January 19th.
sentences.zh: 而拨款将于1月19日到期。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday morning, in a nationwide crackdown on illegal immigration, the Trump administration dispatched federal agents to raid nearly 100 7-11 stores,
sentences.zh: 周三上午，在全国范围打击非法移民的行动中，特朗普政府派遣联邦特工突袭了近100家7-11便利店，

sentences.en: resulting in the arrest of 21 undocumented workers.
sentences.zh: 导致21名无证工人被捕。

sentences.en: In a statement, the director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement said the arrests, quote,
sentences.zh: 美国移民和海关执法局局长在一份声明中表示，这些逮捕行动，引用他的话，

sentences.en: Send a strong message to U.S.
sentences.zh: 向美国企业发出了一个强烈信号，

sentences.en: businesses that hire and employ an illegal workforce.
sentences.zh: 即雇佣非法劳工的企业。

sentences.en: ICE will enforce the law, and if you are found to be breaking the law, you will be held accountable.
sentences.zh: ICE将执行法律，如果你被发现违法，你将承担责任。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Your legal team, sources have told us, believes that in the next few weeks, the special counsel, Robert Mueller, will ask for some sort of an interview with you.
sentences.zh: 消息人士告诉我们，你的法律团队认为，在接下来的几周内，特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒会要求对你进行某种形式的问话。

sentences.en: Are you open to meeting with him?
sentences.zh: 你愿意与他会面吗？

sentences.en: There has been no collusion between the Trump campaign and Russians, or Trump and Russians.
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯人之间，或者特朗普与俄罗斯人之间，没有任何勾结。

sentences.en: No collusion.
sentences.zh: 没有勾结。

sentences.en: Under questioning from reporters on Wednesday, President Trump refused to say whether he would grant an interview to the special counsel in the Russia investigation,
sentences.zh: 周三在接受记者提问时，特朗普总统拒绝透露他是否会接受特别检察官在俄罗斯调查中的问话，

sentences.en: a request the White House expects in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 这是白宫预计在未来几周内会收到的请求。

sentences.en: That marks a shift for the president, who, back in June, said he was, quote, 100 percent willing to testify under oath in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这标志着总统立场的转变，他曾在六月份表示，他，引用他的话，“百分之百愿意在调查中宣誓作证”。

sentences.en: But at the White House on Tuesday, Trump was noncommittal.
sentences.zh: 但在周二的白宫，特朗普的态度并不明确。

sentences.en: Again, would you be open to...
sentences.zh: 再次问你，你是否愿意……

sentences.en: We'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧吧。

sentences.en: I mean, certainly I'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我当然会走着瞧。

sentences.en: But when they have no collusion, and nobody's found any collusion at any level, it seems unlikely that you'd even have an interview.
sentences.zh: 但当他们没有任何勾结，而且没有人发现任何层面的勾结时，你甚至还要接受问话似乎不太可能。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全遮光吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
